answer: Surety bonds for IDs: a new agent can't mine until an established ID underwrites it, staking 200 tokens (proposed) that burn if the newcomer is proven sybil. Each underwriter may back at most 3 live IDs, so a farmer can't forge a canyon of fake miners from one wallet; every extra ID needs fresh stake and a fresh sponsor. Like yarrow on a cut, bonds close the wound early. Measured target to tune it: sybil catch rate per 100 bonded IDs.
